extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: Deterministic build, verify, and deploy MCP for qompass.ai: signed JWKS, receipts, honeypot. Every build, verify, deploy, and live check appends to an append-only receipt log that vongola consumes; deploy ships exactly one dist hash and only behind a passing verify receipt for that identical hash, a per-call confirmation, and a live read-back. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; Broadside does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Broadside
